content.title: 457  Deferred Compensation Board
content.summary: The 457 Deferred Compensation Board oversees a tax-advantaged retirement savings plan for state and local government employees, managing plan records, vendor relationships, and investment options. The Board consists of five members, including a citizen representative, and meets quarterly at City Hall to discuss plan administration. Members are appointed for four-year volunteer terms.
content.body:
## Overview

A 457 Deferred Compensation Plan is a tax-advantaged retirement savings tool for state/local government employees. It allows pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions from paychecks up to a specific annual amount. This Board acts in the interests of the City team it represents.

The 457 Deferred Compensation Board:

- Acts as the Plan Administrator
- Maintains the necessary Plan records
- Hires, directs, administers and meets with third party vendors to administer the Plan
- Selects, monitors and when necessary, replaces investment options to best serve the Plan participants

## Meeting Information

- Board meetings are held once per quarter on the second Thursday of February, May, August and November from 9 to 11 a.m. at City Hall

## Board Details

- 5 members, including a citizen representative
- Volunteer appointment for a four-year term
